propositions: Recursive conftest glob in global_support causes all seven mutation shards to select on any nested conftest change, wasting 5.38 runner-hours across 97 recent runs without loading those fixtures.

Pytest loads only a test directory and its ancestor conftests upward, never sibling fixture trees; runtime tracing confirmed six conftests in the complete loaded union, excluding unrelated branches like tests/external/live_jira_dc/conftest.py.

Per-shard conftest support must map exactly to ancestor chains of configured test paths; only tests/conftest.py is true global, while tests/unit/conftest.py, tests/interfaces/conftest.py, tests/interfaces/store/conftest.py, tests/scripts/conftest.py, and tests/scripts/reducer/conftest.py belong only to shards that load them.

A derived ancestry equality contract expands configured test files and directories, asserts the per-shard manifest support closure equals the computed ancestor set, and fails closed on missing or stale conftest entries.
Unrelated nested conftest changes must select zero mutation shards; each true ancestor conftest change must select exactly its dependent shards.
No existing test coverage, shard source/test mappings, or non-conftest global triggers are removed or weakened; all 374 tests pass with unchanged results.
